description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Squirrel.
Repeat.
